data.gist: A post hoc power analysis (G*Power 3.1, two-tailed t-test, α=0.05) was based on the 12-week knee bend score difference between BMAC and BMAX.
data.plain: Statistical power was calculated after the fact, using the observed BMAC-versus-BMAX difference in the 12-week knee bend pain score, which they treated as the main functional outcome for comparing the two treatments.
